statement: The actual wild class-three arithmetic h quotient over Q3(zeta3), both complete lower central lifting images and geometric-conjugacy fibres, and a constructed intrinsic class-two section with no intrinsic class-three lift.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The arithmetic field is k=Q3(zeta3). The h map is defined over K=Q(zeta3); no unproved descent of its based target to Q3 is imposed.
Coherent roots lambda_n satisfy lambda_n^2=-3_n zeta_(3^(n+1)); their exact path character is -(chi-1)/6-(3/2)kappa3(3).

The original E37 Frobenius marking is transported by the literal E49 conjugation, including its actual free-group automorphism and inner path operator. E77 is applied after this explicitly proved transport over the same quotient P.
The genuine operators have (chi,kappa_a)=(7,-5/2),(7,1/2). All Hall terms through degree3 are retained and evaluated.

The actual source equation uses four independent generator values over k. Its complete class-three error is (Delta R,Delta S), with exact central change336(p-p prime); divisibility by3 is necessary and sufficient.
Nonempty geometric-conjugacy fibres are Z3^2 x C3 at class2 and Z3^4 x C9^2 at class3. Actual representative and inverse conjugator maps are specified; lower stabilizers are proved trivial.

The explicit quotient family has error e^(7(2-N)). Every family member has an intrinsic class-two preimage constructed from an actual cusp conjugator and the central element [x_*,y_*]. The N=2 preimage has a full intrinsic lift and the N=0 preimage has none at class3; their intrinsic abelian coordinates agree.
For arbitrary quotient sections the exact h-kernel remains part of the intrinsic lifting problem. This result does not declare E23 solved.
